# AikiField

> B2B cybersecurity consulting: fractional CISO services, AI-assisted DevSecOps, and security leadership coaching for SaaS and AI-powered product companies. Also hosts a sourced Q&A knowledge layer (Ask AikiField) covering both AikiField services and Richard Moon's public Quantum Aikido teachings.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://aikifield.com/index.html): services overview and outcomes
- [Services](https://aikifield.com/services.html): engagement menu
- [Approach](https://aikifield.com/approach.html): security leadership method
- [Case Studies](https://aikifield.com/case-studies.html): client outcomes
- [Self-Assessment](https://aikifield.com/assessment.html): security maturity + leadership presence
- [AI DevSecOps Remediation](https://aikifield.com/ai-devsecops-vulnerability-remediation.html): 21 days → 3 days workflow
- [Fractional CISO](https://aikifield.com/fractional-ciso.html): SaaS & industrial IoT security leadership
- [Demonstration Technologies](https://aikifield.com/projects.php): sponsored projects
- [Studies the Unified Field — Books](https://aikifield.com/books.html): Richard Moon's books (primary nav: Studies the Unified Field ▸ Books)
- [Author's Insights blog](https://aikifield.com/blog/): essays and talks; social links at /blog/index.html#social
- [Digital Experience](https://aikifield.com/digital-experience/): interactive practices — Ride the Lucky Wave, Verbal Aikido story mode, Moon practices, Unified Field Chat
- [Ask AikiField](https://aikifield.com/ask/): sourced Q&A knowledge layer — questions, books, videos with visible citations

## Not for crawlers

- /beta/ — pre-release assessments (login-gated, Disallow)
- /members, /login.php — Unified Field chat (login-gated)
- /AEO/ — editorial review index (login-gated, Disallow)
- /for-review/ — gated review content (login-gated)

Corrections: https://aikifield.com/contact.html (subject: Ask AikiField correction)
